## **2\. Disclosure Questions**

### **1\. AI tool(s) used:**

### **2\. Stage(s) of the assignment where AI was used:**

\[x\] brainstorming   
\[x\] drafting 

### **3\. Main prompts or tasks given to the AI:**

*Paste the 2–3 most impactful prompts verbatim. For the full transcript, attach Appendix A (prompt\_log.md).*

“ You are a experienced QC/QA searching through the job market for related works, in this document \[https://docs.google.com/document/d/1XjL32sek46qQJiF-vVN1nIn0i1jHrRfg\_EMsKdLk-ss/edit?usp=sharing\] , I've collected 10 QA/QC related work, for each job write a 1-2 sentence critiques.”

“Search for 20 recent software defect (between 2022-2026), in which at least 5 of which is caused by AI. Cite articles in which the defect is mentioned. For each defect, include source link, description, severity, consequences, solution.”

### **4\. Specific parts of the work AI contributed to:**

*Be specific. Example: 'AI generated TC01–TC15 in Section 3.2; I rewrote TC04 and TC11; AI did NOT contribute to Sections 1, 2, 4, or the AI Critique.'*

- AI generated the initial draft of the 10 QA/QC job description critiques.   
- AI generated the initial list of software defects (2022–2026), but I rewrote the section to fix hallucinated URLs and incorrect dates.   
- AI drafted the baseline test cases for the Sharp KS-IH191V-RD rice cooker; I removed hallucinated smart features and manually added hardware-specific edge cases.  
- AI generated the initial text outline and image for the mindmaps, which I modified to fix spelling errors (e.g., "AI Trool"). AI did NOT contribute to the physical device execution videos, the AI Critique, or the Conclusion.

### **5\. How I reviewed, revised, or verified the AI output:**

*Describe your verification method (ran the test, checked the spec, asked the TA, looked up RFC, cross-checked with the ISTQB syllabus, etc.).*

I verified the QA/QC job critiques by reading the original job postings and confirming the AI's analysis aligned with the text. For the software defects list, I manually clicked the AI-provided URLs and searched the reported event dates, which revealed hallucinations; I corrected these by finding valid sources and actual defect dates through Google Search. I reviewed the Sharp rice cooker test cases against the appliance's actual physical specifications and user manual, deleting test cases for non-existent smart features and adding real-world edge cases. I visually inspected the mindmap images and manually corrected typographical errors.
